post.title: Limits on Limits: ICESCR Article 4 and the Standard Algorithmic Systems Don't Meet

payload.note: Article 4 covers the three-part limitation test (determined by law; compatible with the nature of the right; solely for general welfare in a democratic society). Argues that algorithmic management and platform contractor classification operate through private contract, not democratic law — failing Article 4 standard. Siracusa Principles applied. Batch with articles 1-3 + 5 (pending) when Article 5 arrives. ICESCR Article 5 remains the last gap in the series.
